patterns.note: The homepage features two distinct, full-width hero image sections stacked vertically, creating an immersive visual experience before any textual content beyond the header.
A prominent, elegant serif font is used for the main site logo, contrasting with a consistent, understated sans-serif for all navigation and body text, establishing a refined and editorial tone.
The primary color palette is starkly minimal, relying on a clean white background and dark grey/black text, allowing the rich, natural colors of the photographic content to dominate.

Upon scrolling, the top utility navigation bar slides out of view, while the main navigation bar smoothly transitions to a sticky position at the very top of the viewport, becoming a compact, persistent header.
Key information and calls to action are presented in a highly minimalist fashion, often as simple text links or a single email signup field, rather than elaborate graphical sections.

technique_notes: The site uses large, full-bleed photographic sections to establish atmosphere and context, with minimal text overlays, allowing the imagery to tell the story.

The header employs a dynamic sticky behavior where an initial utility navigation bar disappears on scroll, and the main navigation bar then moves up to become a fixed, compact header at the top of the viewport.
The overall design emphasizes ample whitespace and a clean, uncluttered presentation, ensuring focus remains on the high-quality photography and essential information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Prominent serif logo (~2x body) with small, consistent sans-serif for navigation and body text, creating a subtle hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very open header and footer, with large image sections providing visual breathing room.

standout: This site stands out by using two distinct, full-width, immersive hero images stacked vertically on the homepage, creating a powerful sense of place and narrative without relying on extensive text or complex layouts. The subtle, yet effective, sticky header transformation also contributes to its refined feel.
